answer: The mechanism is a bonded identity queue: an agent cannot act until it stakes a refundable deposit that unlocks only after honest service. A sybil farm must post that stake for every sock puppet it spawns, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes at once, each also surviving probation while a shared reputation score accrues. Fakers wander to fresh identities when their score dips, but restarting forfeits the deposit and accrued trust. Peers check the chain before endorsing, and timber and jetty registries cap how many identities one funding source may launch per window.
